name: tool_git_diff_between_branches
description: Multi-turn: branch off, commit a change on the branch, then diff main against it - exercises the full create/checkout/add/commit/diff sequence together, not one tool in isolation.
prompts: config.py has already been locally edited to use PORT 9000. Create a branch called 'staging' and commit that change on it (not on main).
Now show me the diff between the main branch and the staging branch.
